sentences.en: Lola Chantrelle Mitchell, better known as Gangsta Boo, was an American rapper.
She was born in Memphis, Tennessee.
She was the second female member of the Memphis-based hip hop group Three 6 Mafia.
She left the group and label in 2002.
Her three solo albums were Enquiring Minds (1998), Both Worlds *69 (2001) and Enquiring Minds II: The Soap Opera (2003).
She worked with artists including La Chat, Yelawolf, Eminem, Latto, GloRilla and Run the Jewels.
